title: Riding the Fixed-Point Curve: Image Classification in the Continuous Thought Machine
abstract: arXiv:2610.19220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) is a recurrent network that attends to inputs and makes predictions based on the synchronization between its neurons. On tasks spanning many domains, it displays emergent thought processes that have not been explained. We report a number of findings about how the CTM classifies images, focusing on ImageNet. Each thinking step is an attracting but strongly non-normal map exhibiting balanced amplification (Murphy and Miller, 2009); while attraction is already present at CTM initialization, training highly promotes non-normality. By Banach's theorem, the neural state has a locally unique attracting fixed point, which moves at every step, and the thought trajectory is the curve these fixed points trace, followed one tick behind. translated_title: 驾驭不动点曲线：连续思维机器中的图像分类
translated_abstract: 连续思维机器（CTM）是一种循环神经网络，它关注输入并基于神经元之间的同步性做出预测。在跨越多个领域的任务中，它表现出尚未被解释的涌现思维过程。我们报告了关于CTM如何对图像进行分类的多项发现，重点聚焦于ImageNet。每个思考步骤是一个具有吸引性但强烈非正规的映射，表现出平衡放大效应（Murphy and Miller, 2009）；虽然吸引性在CTM初始化时就已存在，但训练极大地促进了非正规性。根据巴拿赫（Banach）定理，神经状态具有一个局部唯一的不动点，该不动点在每一步都会移动，而思维轨迹就是这些不动点所描绘的曲线，滞后一个时间步跟随其后。该曲线的大部分运动在不同图像之间是共享的，并表现为先前报道过的跨越神经元的行波活动。沿着思维的注意力调度……
tldr: 本文揭示了连续思维机器（CTM）图像分类的内在机制：每个思考步骤是具有平衡放大的吸引性非正规映射，神经状态的不动点随每步移动，思维轨迹即这些不动点描绘的曲线（大部分运动跨图像共享并表现为行波活动），从而解释了CTM的涌现思维过程。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the mechanism of image classification in the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM): each thinking step is an attracting, strongly non-normal map with balanced amplification, and the thought trajectory traces the curve of moving attracting fixed points—largely shared across images and visible as a traveling wave—thereby explaining CTM's emergent thought processes.
